name: Copernicus European and Global Drought Observatories (EDO/GDO)
owner: European Commission Joint Research Centre (Copernicus Emergency Management Service)
gives: drought indicators (SPI, SPEI, soil moisture, vegetation, combined drought indicator) as maps and downloads; not reservoir levels

why.quote: users are granted free access to the data
why.basis: terms page quoted by a page reader on 2026-11-18, which cut some sentences short; no page date shown; names no specific licence. Attribution notice asked for: 'Generated using Copernicus Emergency Management Service information [Year]'. robots.txt (https://drought.emergency.copernicus.eu/robots.txt, 200): 'User-agent: * / Disallow:' (nothing disallowed).

interface: Map viewer, WMS and WCS services and downloads listed on the site; no reservoir series seen.
notes: Read 18 Nov 2026: home page and terms. It gives rainfall and soil-dryness context, not the volume of any named dam. Useful only as context for a drought story, not for this dataset. The page does not mention reservoirs. Terms do not address automated access.
